maddeler.e:
يجنا (form I)
# يَجُنَّا (yajunnā) /ja.d͡ʒun.naː/: third-person masculine dual non-past active subjunctive/jussive of جَنَّ (janna)
# يُجَنَّا (yujannā) /ju.d͡ʒan.naː/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of جَنَّ (janna) and جُنَّ (junna)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
